presentation_refactor_history.scope: One mobile filter owner; orphan drawer lifecycle and cascade removed. The Search3 price input no longer opts into the retained legacy DS2 price listener, leaving the Search3 frame-coalesced path as its single input owner. Price-slider labels remain immediate while rapid filtering renders at most once per animation frame with the latest state. Reset, an immediately applied sea/charter change, or a fresh result source cancels a superseded pending price render. Active local filters are reapplied to fresh progressive results before the final count is announced. Sort/same-reference rerenders neither announce a filter change nor rewrite the established count, including a zero-match filtered list. Progressive source updates synchronize price bounds and result count in place, preserving mounted controls and the active price selection; a temporary source contraction clamps only the displayed slider value and restores the user's chosen limit when wider bounds return. The sea-distance facet is visible only when every loaded hotel has a positive seaDistance; an incomplete progressive source hides and resets it before filtering. Result reset clears both budget bounds and both form flight constraints before one desktop submit, restores the unfiltered source once and publishes one final result-count event. The local charter control mirrors the form and restores its hydrated state on search reset. Empty-source price/sea/charter changes synchronize the active-filter count and public event without rendering, while a repeated zero-match render preserves the original source so clearing the filter restores its hotels. Full rail rendering has one reset/initialization contract with no obsolete silent mode. A hotel without tour rows uses its own normalized price directly instead of invoking the removed general price collector.
